question: 진공유도용해-진공아크재용해(VIM–VAR)로 만든 AISI M-50 베어링강에 적용하는 수명계수는 재료, 공정, 최종 값이 각각 얼마인가요?
answer: 재료는 AISI M–50, 공정은 VIM–VAR, 최종 값은 12입니다 [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#111].

translation.text: What is the life factor applied to AISI M-50 bearing steel produced by vacuum induction melting–vacuum arc remelting (VIM–VAR)? What are the material, process, and final values?

question: In the mission profile of the commercial turboprop gearbox, what share of the time is spent in cruise and how much propeller shaft power is delivered in that segment?
answer: In the mission profile of the commercial turboprop gearbox, 68.08 percent of the time is spent in cruise, and 1516 kW (2033 hp) of propeller shaft power is delivered in that segment [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#115].

translation.text: In the mission profile of the commercial turboprop gearbox, what proportion of the time is spent in cruise and how much propeller shaft power is delivered during that phase?

question: Welche L10-Lebensdauer in Stunden sagt die Lundberg-Palmgren-Analyse mit Lebensdauerfaktoren für das Propeller-Axialkugellager des kommerziellen Turboprop-Getriebes voraus?
answer: Die Lundberg-Palmgren-Analyse predicts eine L10-Lebensdauer von 774 Stunden für das Getriebe, wobei die rollerbasierten Lager als die am wenigsten lebenden Komponenten identifiziert werden [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#116]. Die berechnete L10-Lebensdauer für das gesamte Getriebe basiert auf einem Lebensdauerfaktor p = 4 für Rollenlager [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#116]. Die Analyse zeigt jedoch, dass die vorhergesagte Lebensdauer unter dem tatsächlichen Wert von 5627 Stunden liegt, was darauf hindeutet, dass die Standardwerte für p zu konservativ sind [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#125]. translation.text: What L10 life in hours does the Lundberg-Palmgren analysis with life factors predict for the propeller axial ball bearing in the commercial turboprop transmission?

question: 와이블 기반 몬테카를로 시뮬레이션에서 깊은 홈 볼베어링의 고장 중 내륜 고장이 차지하는 비율은 몇 퍼센트였나요?
answer: 와이블 기반 몬테카를로 시뮬레이션에서 깊은 홈 볼베어링의 고장 중 내륜 고장은 70.1%를 차지했습니다 [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#58].

translation.text: What percentage of failures in deep groove ball bearings in a wobble-based Monte Carlo simulation were due to inner ring failures?

question: For a medium-series ball bearing, what is the outer-race to inner-race life ratio Lo/Li for Hertz stress-life exponents of 9 and 12?
answer: For a medium-series ball bearing, the outer-race to inner-race life ratio Lo/Li is 8.36 for a Hertz stress-life exponent of 9 and 16.96 for a Hertz stress-life exponent of 12 [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#73].

translation.text: For a medium-series ball bearing, what is the outer-race to inner-race life ratio Lo/Li for Hertz stress-life exponents of 9 and 12?

question: Welche Last-Lebensdauer- und Spannungs-Lebensdauer-Exponenten ergaben Scotts Vierkugelversuche mit EN-31-Stahl und Diester-Schmierstoff?
answer: Scotts Vierkugelversuche mit EN-31-Stahl und Diester-Schmierstoff ergaben einen Last-Lebensdauer-Exponenten von 3.6 und einen Spannungs-Lebensdauer-Exponenten von 10.8 [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#86].

translation.text: What load life and stress life exponents were obtained from Scott's four-ball tests using EN-31 steel and ester lubricant?

question: 피로한도를 두지 않는 Lundberg-Palmgren 모델에서 최대 헤르츠 응력을 1379 MPa에서 2068 MPa로 올리면 상대 수명은 얼마로 줄어드나요?
answer: 피로한도를 두지 않는 Lundberg-Palmgren 모델에서 최대 헤르츠 응력을 1379 MPa에서 2068 MPa로 올리면 상대 수명은 0.026으로 줄어듭니다 [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#49]. 이 값은 최대 헤르츠 응력이 1379 MPa에서 2068 MPa로 증가했을 때, 상대 수명이 정규화된 상태에서의 값입니다 [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#49].

translation.text: If the Lundberg-Palmgren model, which does not consider fatigue limit, is used and the maximum Hertz stress is increased from 1379 MPa to 2068 MPa, by what factor does the relative life decrease?

question: How much compressive residual stress does AMS 6278 (VIM-VAR M50 NiL) have from heat treatment, and what is its theoretical relative life at a maximum Hertz stress of 1.4 GPa compared with AISI M-50?
answer: AMS 6278 (VIM–VAR M50 NiL) has a compressive residual stress of 0.4 GPa (58 ksi) from heat treatment [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#97]. Its theoretical relative life at a maximum Hertz stress of 1.4 GPa is 280×10⁻², compared with 1 for AISI M–50 [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#97].

translation.text: What is the compressive residual stress of AMS 6278 (VIM-VAR M50 NiL) resulting from heat treatment, and what is its theoretical relative life at a maximum Hertz stress of 1.4 GPa compared to AISI M50?

question: 구름 베어링 크기별 형상·재료 계수 fcm 대표값은 ANSI/ABMA의 몇 번 규격에 나오나요?
answer: 구름 베어링 크기별 형상·재료 계수 fcm 대표값은 ANSI/ABMA의 9번과 11번 규격에 나오나요 [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#39].

translation.text: What are the representative values of the shape and material factors fcm for rolling bearings of different sizes, and in which ANSI/ABMA standard are they specified?

question: In the NASA review of rolling-element bearing life prediction, which figure shows Wöhler-type stress-cycle curves with an endurance limit, and which source is it credited to?
answer: Figure 27(b) shows Wöhler-type stress-cycle curves with an endurance limit [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#127]. This is credited to Wohler's work, as the text states that Wohler was seeking to determine what was later determined as an "endurance limit" or "fatigue limit" [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#127].

translation.text: In the NASA review of rolling-element bearing life prediction, which figure shows Wöhler-type stress-cycle curves with an endurance limit, and which source is it credited to?

question: Welche Schmiegung an Innen- und Außenring liegt den nach Einführungsjahr aufgelisteten fcm-Werten der ANSI/ABMA-Norm 9 für Kugellager zugrunde?
answer: Die Schmiegung an Innen- und Außenring liegt den nach Einführungsjahr aufgelisteten fcm-Werten der ANSI/ABMA-Norm 9 für Kugellager zugrunde, nämlich 0,52 [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#40].

translation.text: What inner and outer ring clearance is based on the listed fcm values of the ANSI/ABMA standard 9 for ball bearings according to introduction year?

question: Unterhalb welcher maximalen Hertzschen Pressung arbeiten praktisch alle Wälzlager in rotierenden Maschinen?
answer: Praktisch alle Wälzlager in rotierenden Maschinen arbeiten unter einer maximalen Hertzschen Pressung von 2,1 GPa (300 ksi) [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#89].

translation.text: Below what maximum Hertzian pressure do practically all rolling bearings in rotating machinery operate?

question: Out of the roughly 224,000 airline engine bearings that came back for repair, how many had to be scrapped because of spalling fatigue?
answer: Out of the roughly 224,000 airline engine bearings that came back for repair, 1,977 were rejected because of fatigue, but the specific number attributed to spalling fatigue is not provided in the context. [nasa-tm-2017-219545#3] The data indicate that fatigue failures are generally not classified as spalling fatigue, and no subset of the fatigue failures is specified as spalling. [nasa-tm-2017-219545#27] Therefore, the exact number of bearings scrapped due to spalling fatigue cannot be determined from the given information.

translation.text: Out of the roughly 224,000 airline engine bearings that came back for repair, how many had to be scrapped due to spalling fatigue?

question: Cunningham과 Morgan이 해군 항공 정비시설(Naval Air Rework Facility)에서 베어링 폐기 원인 데이터를 모은 표본 기간은 어느 해였고, 한 번에 며칠씩이었나요?
answer: Cunningham과 Morgan은 1969년, 1971년, 그리고 1977년 동안 각각 80일간의 기간을 설정하여 베어링 폐기 원인 데이터를 모으었습니다 [nasa-tm-2017-219545#19]. 각 표본 기간은 80일이었습니다 [nasa-tm-2017-219545#10].

translation.text: What was the sample period and how many days at a time did Cunningham and Morgan collect bearing disposal reason data at the Naval Air Rework Facility?

question: Wie viel Prozent der Lager wären laut der auf die Naval-Air-Rework-Daten gestützten Analyse bereits ausgebaut, wenn die rechnerische L10-Ermüdungslebensdauer von 5000 h erreicht ist?
answer: Laut der auf die Naval Air Rework Facility-Daten gestützten Analyse wären 97 Prozent der Lager bereits ausgebaut, wenn die rechnerische L10-Ermüdungslebensdauer von 5.000 h erreicht ist [nasa-tm-2017-219545#22]. Dies wird in der Analyse explizit genannt, bei der festgestellt wird, dass bei 5.000 h (dem L10-Ermüdungslebensdauer) 97 Prozent der Lager aus dem Betrieb entfernt werden [nasa-tm-2017-219545#23]. Die Angabe ist konsistent in mehreren Quellen, einschließlich der Daten aus dem Naval Air Rework Facility [nasa-tm-2017-219545#34].

translation.text: What percentage of the bearings would already have been retired according to the analysis based on Naval Air Rework data, when the calculated L10 fatigue life reaches 5000 hours?

question: In the service life analysis built on the Naval Air Rework Facility removal data, which cause for removal gives the shortest bearing life?
answer: Corrosion pitting gives the shortest bearing life in the service life analysis built on the Naval Air Rework Facility removal data. [nasa-tm-2017-219545#24] This is because "corrosion pitting" is identified as the lowest lived failure mode, meaning it occurs at the earliest time compared to other failure modes. [nasa-tm-2017-219545#24] As a result, it dominates bearing failures and serves as a good approximation for the system Weibull properties. [nasa-tm-2017-219545#24]

translation.text: In the service life analysis based on the Naval Air Rework Facility removal data, which failure cause results in the shortest bearing life?

question: 베어링을 새로 사는 대신 재가공(rework)해서 다시 쓰면 신품 대비 비용을 얼마나 아낄 수 있나요?
answer: 베어링을 새로 사는 대신 재가공(rework)해서 다시 쓰면, 비용이 새 베어링 대비 53%에서 82%까지 절약될 수 있습니다 [nasa-tm-2017-219545#2]. 이 비용 절감은 베어링의 크기, 복잡성, 그리고 재가공의 범위에 따라 달라질 수 있습니다 [nasa-tm-2017-219545#2].

translation.text: How much cost can be saved by reworking and reusing bearings instead of purchasing new ones compared to original equipment?

question: Auf welche Lebensdauer waren die Hauptwellenlager von Fluggasturbinen Anfang der 1950er-Jahre begrenzt?
answer: Die Hauptwellenlager von Fluggasturbinen waren Anfang der 1950er-Jahre auf eine Lebensdauer von etwa 300 Stunden begrenzt [nasa-tm-2017-219545#9]. Diese Grenze war eng mit der Fatiguelast der Rollkörperelemente verbunden, die die Lebensdauer und Zuverlässigkeit der Motoren bestimmen [nasa-tm-2017-219545#32].

translation.text: What was the rated life limit of the main shaft bearings in aircraft gas turbines at the beginning of the 1950s?

question: Sugiura et al. ran rolling contact tests on fully crowned rollers with several crown radii. How much shorter was life because of edge loading than the central contact stress alone would suggest?
answer: The life was reduced by approximately 30 percent due to edge loading compared to the effect of stress at the center of the contact area. [nasa-tm-2015-218895#7]

translation.text: Sugiura et al. conducted rolling contact tests on fully crowned rollers with various crown radii. How much shorter was the life due to edge loading compared to what central contact stress alone would predict?

question: 210 사이즈 원통 롤러 베어링에 기준 하중 29,190 N을 걸었을 때, 에어로스페이스 롤러 프로파일(평탄부 8 mm + 곡률 반경 크라운)에서 내륜 최대 헤르츠 응력은 얼마인가요?
answer: 에어로스페이스 롤러 프로파일에서 내륜 최대 헤르츠 응력은 2240 MPa (325 ksi)입니다 [nasa-tm-2015-218895#19].

translation.text: What is the maximum Hertz stress on the inner ring when a basic load of 29,190 N is applied to a 210-size cylindrical roller bearing with an aerospace roller profile (flat section 8 mm + crown curvature radius)?

question: Auf welchen Wert sinkt nach Lundberg-Palmgren der Last-Lebensdauer-Exponent p bei Zylinderrollen mit sehr starker Vollbombierung (Bombierradius R = 100·d) im Vergleich zu unbombierten Rollen?
answer: Der Last-Lebensdauer-Exponent p sinkt bei Zylinderrollen mit sehr starker Vollbombierung (R = 100·d) von p = 4 (für unbombierte Rollen) auf p = 3.1 [nasa-tm-2015-218895#20].

translation.text: To what value does the load life exponent p decrease according to the Lundberg-Palmgren equation for cylinder rollers with very strong full bombardment (bombardment radius R = 100·d) compared to unbombarded rollers?

question: If I size a cylindrical roller bearing with Zaretsky's life equation and the rollers have an aerospace-type or chamfered end relief, which load exponent should I use, and how does it differ from uncrowned and fully crowned rollers?
answer: For cylindrical roller bearings with an aerospace-type or chamfered end relief, you should use a load-life exponent of p = 4.6 according to the Zaretsky life model [nasa-tm-2015-218895#3]. This is lower than the p = 5.0 exponent for flat (uncrowned) rollers, reflecting the effect of end relief on reducing the load-life exponent [nasa-tm-2015-218895#2]. It is higher than the p = 4.3 exponent for fully crowned rollers, indicating that aerospace or chamfered profiles offer a balance between improved load distribution and reduced life prediction compared to fully crowned rollers [nasa-tm-2015-218895#2].

translation.text: If I size a cylindrical roller bearing using Zaretsky's life equation and the rollers have an aerospace-type or chamfered end relief, which load exponent should I use, and how does it differ from uncrowned and fully crowned rollers?

question: 상용 터보프롭 기어박스의 현장 수명 데이터와 비교하면, Lundberg-Palmgren 방식은 기어박스의 L10 수명을 몇 배나 낮게 예측했나요?
answer: Lundberg-Palmgren 방식은 상용 터보프롭 기어박스의 L10 수명을 7.56배나 낮게 예측했습니다. [nasa-tp-2013-215305-rev1#122] 이 데이터는 현장 수명이 5627시간이었고, Lundberg-Palmgren 모델로 예측된 수명은 774시간이었기 때문입니다. [nasa-tm-2015-218895#23] 이는 실제 수명보다 예측된 수명이 훨씬 낮음을 나타냅니다.

translation.text: Compared to field life data of commercial turboprop gearboxes, by how many times did the Lundberg-Palmgren method underestimate the gearbox's L10 life?

question: Worauf gingen die Ausfälle der im Feld beobachteten Turboprop-Getriebe zurück: Welcher Anteil entfiel auf die Planetenlager und welcher auf die Zahnräder?
answer: Die Ausfälle der im Feld beobachteten Turboprop-Getriebe gingen etwa 90 Prozent auf die Planetenlager zurück, weniger als 2 Prozent auf die Zahnräder und der Rest auf andere Lager [nasa-tm-2015-218895#2]. Der Anteil der Planetenlager betrug somit etwa 90 Prozent [nasa-tm-2015-218895#25]. Der Anteil der Zahnräder betrug weniger als 2 Prozent [nasa-tm-2015-218895#25].

translation.text: What were the causes of the field-observed turboprop gearbox failures: what proportion was attributable to planetary bearings and what proportion to gear teeth?

question: In the full-factorial slip measurements on the full-complement NUP 2208 cylindrical roller bearing, over what shaft speed range was the speed varied and in what step size?
answer: The shaft speed was varied over the range of 900 to 2700 min⁻¹ with a step size of 450 min⁻¹ [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#85].

translation.text: In the full-factorial slip measurements on the full-complement NUP 2208 cylindrical roller bearing, over what shaft speed range was the speed varied and in what step size?

question: 총형 원통롤러베어링 스미어링 시험에 쓴 두 가지 유압유에서, 표준 첨가제 오일과 저첨가 오일의 황(S) 함량은 각각 몇 mg/kg인가요?
answer: 표준 첨가제 오일의 황(S) 함량은 2975 mg/kg입니다 [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#176]. 저첨가 오일의 황(S) 함량은 489 mg/kg입니다 [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#176].

translation.text: In the total-type cylindrical roller bearing smearing test using two hydraulic oils, what are the sulfur (S) contents, in mg/kg, for the standard additive oil and the low-additive oil respectively?

question: Welche Radialkraft wurde in der Einzelparametervariation der Anschmierversuche am vollrolligen Zylinderrollenlager als hohe Stufe gefahren, und traten dabei Anschmierungen auf?
answer: In der Einzelparametervariation wurde eine Radialkraft von 50 kN als hohe Stufe gefahren, und dabei traten Anschmierungen auf [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#136].

translation.text: What radial load was applied during the individual parameter variation of the lubrication tests on the fully rolling cylindrical roller bearing at high level, and did lubrication occur under these conditions?

question: In the central composite test plan for smearing of the full-complement NUP 2208 bearing, which three levels of mounted radial clearance were used?
answer: The three levels of mounted radial clearance used in the central composite test plan for smearing of the full-complement NUP 2208 bearing are 16 µm, 22 µm, and 28 µm [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#145].

translation.text: In the central composite test plan for smearing of the full-complement NUP 2208 bearing, which three levels of mounted radial clearance were used?

question: NUP 2208 총형 원통롤러베어링의 스미어링 시험에 사용한 유압유의 ISO 점도 등급은 무엇인가요?
answer: NUP 2208 총형 원통롤러베어링의 스미어링 시험에 사용한 유압유의 ISO 점도 등급은 32입니다 [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#122].

translation.text: What was the ISO viscosity grade of the hydraulic oil used in the smearing test of the NUP 2208 cylindrical roller bearing?

answer: Das vollrollige NUP 2208 schmierte bei 1350 min−1, 35 kN Radial-, 2,3 kN Axialkraft und 70 °C mit einer Schadensklasse 3 trotz reduzierter axialer Luft am Außenring und 60 min Einlauf [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#173]. Dies ist in der Tabelle 11 für Nr. 18 zu finden, wo die Schadensklasse 3 bei diesen Bedingungen aufgeführt ist [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#173]. Die reduzierte axiale Luft wird in Tabelle 13 und Tabelle 16 diskutiert, aber die Schadensklasse bleibt bei 3 [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#170][luh-diss-stuhler-2024#179]. translation.text: What was the contamination level (damage class) of the fully loaded NUP 2208 bearing operating at 1350 min⁻¹, 35 kN radial load, 2.3 kN axial load, and 70 °C, despite reduced axial air flow at the outer ring and 60 minutes of break-in?

question: In welcher Abbildung der Dissertation zu Schlupf und Anschmierungen in vollrolligen Zylinderrollenlagern sieht man, wie die Messspule und die mit Magnet präparierte Rolle zur Messung der Rollendrehzahl aufgebaut sind?
answer: In Abbildung 12 (a) und (b) wird die Aufbauweise der Messspule und der mit Magnet präparierten Rolle zur Messung der Rollendrehzahl dargestellt [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#48]. Die Spule ist koaxial zum Wälzkörpersatz angeordnet und wird mit einem diametral geteilten Magnet verwendet [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#189]. Der Wälzkörper ist mit einem durchgehenden Stift versehen, der sowohl den Abstand zwischen Spule und Magneten reduziert als auch die Drehzahlinformation ermöglicht [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#48].

question: Which table of the smearing study on full-complement cylindrical roller bearings collects the energy-based criteria from earlier work for predicting the risk of smearing?
answer: Tabelle 1 collects the energy-based criteria from earlier work for predicting the risk of smearing [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#26]. This table includes parameters such as fresslast, lokale Reibenergie, and spezifische Reibenergie, which are used to assess the risk of smearing [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#26]. The values and units provided in the table are derived from previous studies and are relevant for predicting smearing under specific operating conditions [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#26]. The table is referenced as part of the established energetic criteria for smearing prediction [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#26].

question: NUP 2208 총형 원통롤러베어링의 단일 파라미터 변화 스미어링 시험에서, 시작 시 오일 온도를 몇 °C만 높여도 스미어링이 생기지 않았나요?
answer: 시작 시 오일 온도를 11°C만 높여도 스미어링이 생기지 않았습니다 [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#135]. 이는 오일 온도가 스미어링 발생에 매우 민감하다는 것을 보여줍니다 [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#193]. 스미어링은 고온에서 발생하지 않으며, 오히려 11°C 높은 온도는 스미어링을 방지합니다 [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#135].

question: What roller mass and roller-set pitch diameter were used to compute the centrifugal force on the rollers of the NUP 2208 test bearing?
answer: The roller mass (mwk) used was 11.2 g, and the roller-set pitch diameter (dws) was 54.5 mm [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#99].

translation.text: What roller mass and roller-set pitch diameter were used to compute the centrifugal force on the rollers of the NUP 2208 test bearing?

question: Wie teilt sich im Wälzlagerprüfstand mit dem vollrolligen Prüflager NUP 2208 die aufgebrachte Last zwischen Prüflager und Gleitlager auf?
answer: Das Prüflager NUP 2208 nimmt die vollständige Axialkraft Fax und 67 % der exzentrisch aufgebrachten Radialkraft Frad auf. Die restlichen 33 % der Radialkraft werden vom Gleitlager übernommen [luh-diss-stuhler-2024#45].

question: Which oil was used for all the experiments with rotating radial shaft seals at IMKT, and why was that oil chosen?
answer: The oil used for all the experiments with rotating radial shaft seals at IMKT was the mineralistic FVA Reference Oil Nr. 3 without Anglamol1 [luh-diss-pelzer-2022#70]. question: Aus welchem Werkstoff bestehen die Standard-Prüfdichtungen in den Untersuchungen zu rotierenden Radial-Wellendichtringen, und sind sie mit Feder ausgeführt?

question: For the rotating 120 mm radial shaft seal, at roughly what speed does the analytically computed remaining radial force drop to zero when the hydrostatic oil force is not yet included?
answer: The analytically computed remaining radial force drops to zero at approximately 1900 1/min when the hydrostatic oil force is not yet included [luh-diss-pelzer-2022#85]. This is indicated by the point where the calculated remaining radial force curve intersects the x-axis in Abbildung 5.21 [luh-diss-pelzer-2022#85]. The calculation shows that this critical speed corresponds to the point where the dynamic radial force is balanced by the centrifugal force [luh-diss-pelzer-2022#85]. The measured ablation of the seal occurs slightly later, at 2400 1/min, indicating a difference of 500 1/min [luh-diss-pelzer-2022#86].

question: Wie wirkt sich bei einem rotierenden Radial-Wellendichtring ein höherer Ölfüllgrad der rotierenden Kammer auf das Reibmoment und das Abheben der Dichtlippe aus?
answer: Ein höherer Ölfüllgrad der rotierenden Kammer führt zu einem größeren hydrostatischen Druck auf die Dichtlippe, was zu größeren Reibmomenten führt [luh-diss-pelzer-2022#88]. Dieser erhöhte Druck kann das Abheben der Dichtung verursachen, da der hydrostatische Druck bei übermäßiger Füllung zu einer Minderung der Radialkraft führt, was das Kräftegleichgewicht stört [luh-diss-pelzer-2022#88]. Die Reibmomente können dabei stark abfallen, wenn Öl aus der Kammer hinausspritzt, was wiederum die Radialkraft verringert und erst dann ein neues Kräftegleichgewicht entsteht [luh-diss-pelzer-2022#88].
